periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, with the primary axis of the patches angled at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal, converging towards the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertically elongated ovoid morphology with an approximate width-to-height ratio of 0.7:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced inferior expansion and tapering, resulting in a teardrop-shaped profile with a lower geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior edge with a relatively flat profile across the dorsal midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Moderately thick transverse band occupying approximately 35% of the visible thoracic region.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation where the gap between the medial boundaries is approximately 1.5 times the width of an individual pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Highly smooth, semi-circular convex curvature at the superior margins of the ears.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct brownish-yellow organic discoloration present on the ventral fur of the thoracic and abdominal regions.
